page_title: MON 2-4 PSG | Monaco v PSG 18/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Francois Letexier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' 2 - 4 What a goal that is! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Philipp Kohn and into the net. 2:4.
90+4' Referee Francois Letexier has finally had enough of Adi Hutter and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+4' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+2' Kang-In Lee (PSG) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper made a brilliant save and deflected the ball onto the post. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Mohammed Salisu and he is replaced by George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
89' The game has come to an end for Aleksandr Golovin. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eliot Matazo (Monaco).
86' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fires a powerful volley towards goal, but his shot lacks accuracy and is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.

83' 2 - 3 Goncalo Ramos (PSG) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Kang-In Lee. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 2:3.
83' PSG win a corner.
83' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' Substitution. Desire Doue leaves the pitch and is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
79' Breel Embolo (Monaco) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
74' Problems for Adi Hutter as Lamine Camara is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Takumi Minamino (Monaco) replaces him.
74' The game is interrupted now, Lamine Camara (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Desire Doue (PSG) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
71' Desire Doue (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Matvey Safonov (PSG) is able to continue to play.
67' Matvey Safonov (PSG) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Vitinha (PSG) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
66' Good work from PSG as they win a corner.
65' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) replaces Joao Neves.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bradley Barcola leaves the pitch and Kang-In Lee (PSG) comes on.
64' 2 - 2 Goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:2.
64' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Philipp Kohn easily deals with the threat.
60' 2 - 1 What a hit! Breel Embolo (Monaco) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
59' The referee blows his whistle after Willian Pacho (PSG) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
56' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Matvey Safonov.
53' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' Marquinhos (PSG) handles the ball inside the penalty area. No point in arguing there. Monaco will take a penalty kick.
50' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' The resulting corner, taken by Ousmane Dembele (PSG), comes to nothing.
45+6' Breel Embolo (Monaco) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
45+4' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
45+2' Marquinhos (PSG) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His header goes to the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn is alert and manages to keep the ball out.
45+1' The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
42' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

42' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Desire Doue (PSG), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.

42' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Philipp Kohn was alert and made a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to PSG.
40' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
35' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
34' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
30' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
29' Lamine Camara (Monaco) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
28' Flag goes up against Breel Embolo (Monaco) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
24' 0 - 1 What a goal! Achraf Hakimi plays it to Desire Doue (PSG), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Philipp Kohn into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
22' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Luis Enrique has decided that Matvey Safonov is the man to take his place.
17' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' The foul by Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Francois Letexier.
12' Breel Embolo (Monaco) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.

11' Joao Neves (PSG) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the right side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort.
10' The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' Gianluigi Donnarumma blocks Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco)'s effort from the edge of the box.

6' Bradley Barcola (PSG) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Philipp Kohn anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
4' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
1' Breel Embolo (Monaco) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Francois Letexier was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
